cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original full-bleed portrait 4:5 opaque fantasy poker ability card illustration. Classic Hearthstone-like hand-painted spell artwork, thick gouache-like brush marks, exaggerated chunky forms, intentional sharp edges, high color and value contrast. A single decisive readable visual action, one clearly focused color accent and a grounded painted environment. Important shapes inside central 65% of width and height; readable with modest centered crop. Do not depict people or characters in any form: no bodies, hands, fingers, faces, silhouettes, reflections, portraits, body parts, living figures, or spectators, foreground or background. Props and magic alone act. No letters, digits, text, UI, card frame, logo or watermark. A poker card as a prop may show simple suit symbols, no written rank. No photographic finish, glossy 3D or flat white-backed icon. Use no existing artwork or visual reference. Current card mechanic for context only, never print: 五选其一 — 随机锁定一张底牌，从五张随机候选中选一张替换。 Visual concept: Show exactly five possible replacement poker cards arranged like a vivid staggered fan, each physically separate and countable, with a single chosen middle candidate edged in intense pale turquoise. In the foreground an angular brass latch holds one face-down hole card inside a marked empty-table slot, while its unselected partner rests beside it; a single clean streak of blue light points from the chosen candidate to the locked slot. Composition favors the five candidates and the one focused choice. Verdigris, indigo, cyan and warm bronze.
